title: Capacity hedge proforma: mosaic scenarios
body:
Purpose:
Quick proforma for a layered (mosaic) capacity-hedge to protect gross margin during demand surges while preserving runway. Combines: small reserved GPU pool, contractor surge band, temporary price floors for existing enterprise commit, and short-term promo caps for self-serve to control unit economics. Use this as a working sheet for Q2 planning and sales/ops coordination.

Key assumptions (baseline):
- FY26 run-rate tokens/month baseline: 120B
- Effective blended price per 1k tokens (baseline): $0.012
- GPU reserve (small) monthly fixed cost: $90,000 for initial tranche (covers ~3% surge demand)
- Average fully-loaded FTE cost (engineering/ops): $220k/year (~$18.3k/mo)
- Contractor surge cost: $140/hr loaded, up to 2,000 hrs/month in peak
- Target gross margin (post infra/op): 45% baseline

Scenario table (summary):
CSV format: scenario, months, incremental-FTEs, contractor-hours-peak, gpu-reserve-cost/mo, blended-price-1k, projected-gross-margin
Baseline, Q2-Q4, 0, 0, $90,000, $0.012, 45%
Warm-Surge (+30% volume), Q3, +6, 1,000, $140,000, $0.011, 38%
Hot-Surge (+80% volume), Q3-Q4, +18, 2,000, $270,000, $0.010, 28%
Managed-Hedge (mosaic), Q3, +4, 800, $150,000, $0.0125 (tiered), 43%

Explanation of Managed-Hedge (mosaic):
- Add small reserved GPU tranche (covers first 25% of surge).
- Rapid-hire contractor band (pre-approved SOW) to absorb burst requests for 6-8 weeks.
- Apply a tiered pricing tweak: increase committed customer floor by 5% (to protect margin) while offering limited-time credits to top-of-funnel self-serve with hard caps.
- Operational gating: autoscale policy to route non-critical low-SLA traffic to spot-backed pool.

Sensitivity matrix (pricing vs margin):
Rows = price change (%), Columns = scenario impact on margin (Baseline / Managed-Hedge / Hot-Surge)
-20% price => Baseline: 25%, Managed-Hedge: 30%, Hot-Surge: 15%
-10% price => Baseline: 35%, Managed-Hedge: 38%, Hot-Surge: 24%
0% price => Baseline: 45%, Managed-Hedge: 43%, Hot-Surge: 28%
+10% price => Baseline: 52%, Managed-Hedge: 50%, Hot-Surge: 34%
+20% price => Baseline: 58%, Managed-Hedge: 56%, Hot-Surge: 40%

Breakeven heuristics (quick checks):
- Additional committed customers required at $0.0125 to offset one senior infra FTE (fully-loaded $300k/year): ~10M incremental 1k-token units/mo (rough calc).
- Contractor strategy breakeven for 2,000 hrs at $140/hr = $280k/mo vs hiring 3 FTEs (~$55k/mo each) => contractor cheaper for <6 months.

Runway & cash flow impact (6-month view):
- One-time setup/contractor onboarding reserve: $180k (operational buy-in + legal + vendor set-up)
- GPU reserve incremental for 3 months during Q3: $270k
- Expected incremental revenue under Managed-Hedge at conservative uptake (30% of surge captured at tiered pricing): +$420k/mo incremental revenue with 43% margin => ~$180k/mo incremental gross contribution.
- Net cash delta (3 months) with above: -$270k (capex) + $540k contribution = +$270k (positive short-term).

Open questions / decisions required:
- Approve headcount flex budget: can we pre-authorize up to 6 contractor FTE-equivalents and 4 short-term hires for SRE/Infra? (owner: Eng Ops)
- Legal: pre-approved contractor SOW template for rapid onboarding (owner: Legal)
- Sales: commit to short-term price-floor language for enterprise renewals (owner: Sales Finance)
- Product: gating policy to mark non-critical traffic for spot/offload during surge (owner: Platform Eng)

Action items (next 2 weeks):
- Finance: model cash flow variant with conservative convert rates (Evan)
- Eng Ops: validate autoscale QPS thresholds and estimate real-world spot-savings (Clara)
- Legal: draft contractor SOW (Marcus)
- Go-to-market: prepare comms for enterprise customers for pricing-floor pilot (Nina + Sales)

Appendix (quick calc snippets):
- FTE monthly cost formula used: (base comp + benefits + infra allocation + overhead) / 12 -> $220k/12 = $18,333
- Contractor all-in monthly for 2,000 hrs = 2,000 * $140 = $280,000
- GPU reserve sizing: $90k tranche covers ~3% baseline based on current utilization curves (from infra telemetry, ref Confluence page).

Notes to self: this is a working proforma — keep numbers conservative, annotate each assumption with telemetry link, and run Monte Carlo once owners approve the hedge knobs.

References:
- Confluence: Capacity Hedge Playbook (link in metadata)
- Jira: JIRA-8762 (surge test plan)
- Related PR: github.com/redwood-inference/finance-playbooks/PR-214

Document status: working sheet -> will convert to a formal proforma spreadsheet after approvals.
